metadata.legal_basis: Delhi Financial Rules, 2021 & Allocation of Business Rules

blocks.text: ORDER: SANCTION OF SPECIAL ADMINISTRATIVE AND DEVELOPMENT GRANT

Sanction of the Competent Authority is hereby accorded in terms of Rule 21 of Delhi Financial Rules for the release and expenditure of capital funds amounting to INR 45,50,00,000/- (Rupees Forty-Five Crore Fifty Lakhs only) towards the Modernization of Municipal Administrative Infrastructure for the Financial Year 2026-27.

blocks.title: HEAD OF ACCOUNT AND FINANCIAL ALLOCATION

children.text: The expenditure sanctioned above shall be debitable to the detailed heads of accounts as categorized below:

items: The funds shall be utilized strictly for the specific purpose sanctioned and no diversion shall be permitted without prior concurrence of Finance Department.
Utilization Certificates (UC) in GFR-12A format must be furnished to the Principal Accountant General (Audit) within three months of closure of the financial quarter.
All procurement and contracting activities must strictly comply with the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) mandatory directives and CVC guidelines.

blocks.text: Mandatory quarterly audit by the Directorate of Internal Audit is prescribed before release of subsequent tranche.

blocks.name: Dr. Rajeshwar Sharma, IAS
